question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**just as**" is used to show a clear similarity between two actions or events. In this context, it correctly compares the disappearance of the pin with the disappearance of the ship.
 
• **"Alike"** is not suitable as it is generally used to compare characteristics, not actions.
 
• **"By the way" **is incorrect because it is used to introduce a new topic or idea, not to make a comparison.
 
• **"The same" **does not fit well here as it suggests identical actions or things, which is less precise than "just as."

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *You will see the pin disappear, just as__ a ship does on the earth.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Just as (जैसे ही)**: Used to show a comparison or similarity between two actions.
 
• **Alike (एक जैसे)**: Used to show resemblance, typically in appearance or characteristics.
 
• **By the way (वैसे भी)**: Used to introduce a new topic or to mention something incidentally.
 
• **The same (वही)**: Used to indicate identical objects or actions.
